findings.title: Payment callback credits balance without authenticity check
findings.control_gap: decoded order owner is never compared with callback.from.id
preconditions: attacker can press a button in their own chat
order id is guessable or leaked
findings.evidence: line 44 decodes uid from callback data; line 52 calls credit(uid, 100) with no actor comparison
findings.control_elsewhere: no middleware on the router; the service layer does not check either
findings.impact: any user can credit an arbitrary account, repeatable, directly money-equivalent
findings.root_cause: payload carries the subject; authorization was assumed from the inline keyboard
findings.remediation: derive the subject from callback.from.id, verify order ownership in the service layer, add an idempotency key on the order
findings.verification: in an isolated copy with two fixture users, press the button from user B with user A's payload; expect rejection

findings.title: Successful payment handler is not idempotent
findings.control_gap: credit keyed on the update, no unique constraint on telegram_payment_charge_id found
preconditions: webhook redelivery or a crash between credit and commit
findings.control_elsewhere: grep found no unique index; runtime isolation not available to confirm
findings.remediation: insert charge id into a ledger with a unique constraint, credit in the same transaction
findings.verification: replay the same update twice against a scratch database

findings.title: Webhook endpoint accepts unauthenticated updates
findings.control_gap: no X-Telegram-Bot-Api-Secret-Token comparison in application code
preconditions: the public endpoint is reachable without a gateway
findings.control_elsewhere: deploy/nginx.conf may restrict by path; whether it authenticates is unknown from the repo
findings.impact: forged updates impersonate any user if the endpoint is public
findings.remediation: generate a per-environment secret, compare with hmac.compare_digest, reject before parsing
findings.verification: inspect the deployed nginx config and the setWebhook secret_token value

findings.title: f-string SQL in the order lookup
findings.impact: none demonstrated: the value is cast to int at the call boundary
findings.remediation: use a bound parameter for consistency with the rest of the module

coverage.notes: state machine documented in the report
advisory lookup deferred to the owner
Dockerfile runs as root; noted in the report

limitations: no staging database for concurrency testing
runtime isolation level of the production database unknown
